title: French Construction Materials (NF/DTU 2026) Open Reference Dataset & Calculation Engine (Concrete, Aggregates, Blocks, Tiles, Paint)
description: Structured 2026 open datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM JavaScript formulas published by CalculMatériaux (calculmateriaux.com) aligned with French NF and DTU construction standards (NF EN 206/CN, NF EN 771-3, NF DTU 13.3, 20.1, 52.2, 59.1) for France, Belgium, Switzerland, and Quebec. Includes concrete mix and bag yields (https://calculmateriaux.com/calcul-beton/), concrete block counts (https://calculmateriaux.com/calcul-parpaing/), aggregate bulk densities, tiling waste margins, and paint coverage.
